policy.mutation: Visible approved QA/source controls only; DOM evaluation read-only diagnostics
policy.fixtureSearch: Bounded actual source-command generation after slot release, own serial below-normal worker; refuse unmet phases. No synthetic pose/need/position or free care/refill.
policy.grant: Historical synthetic grant/home setup is validation-only; neither budget/exactly-once nor public V5 adoption is accepted here.
policy.baselineIndependence: V4 phase cases and V5 cases have distinct codec/schema/generation/file identities. Historical ticks do not stand in for current phase evidence.
policy.coverage: Observe union of real constructor IDs; every missing site gets explicit source/trigger review. Construction is not visual PASS. Unknown/unobserved is never automatic NA.
policy.camera: Four angles for every actor/facility/phase family; quality/motion/locale/viewport combinations are representative pairwise, not every Cartesian product.
policy.capture: Compact reviewed screenshots/contact sheets only after inspecting real native pixels. Retain useful discovery/media; no bulk deletion.
